_figmaLibraryState.note: The linked Base Gallery community file has only FOUR published components, all named "Badge=none". get_code_connect_map returns {} and get_code_connect_suggestions reports "No published components found". Node 3:4200 is the PAGE "Base Components", not a component. Most of the 3,499 instances are unpublished local components, so there is very little in this file to map against.
_figmaLibraryState.implication: Real Code Connect needs published components. Either get access to Uber's internal Base library, or publish our own project library first. See _codeConnect below.

_codeConnect.how: Code Connect DOES support plain HTML and CSS with no React, via framework-agnostic template files using the figma.html / figma.code tags. The @figma/code-connect/html entrypoint ships figma.className([...]), which composes CSS class lists from Figma variants - purpose-built for a u- kit.
_codeConnect.licensing: Satisfied. Arbisoft is org tier with a Full seat, which is what Code Connect requires.
_codeConnect.warning: Framework-specific parsers are DEPRECATED as of @figma/code-connect 2.0.1. Template files are the only actively maintained route. Do not follow an older HTML-parser tutorial.
_codeConnect.blockedBy: Nothing published in the Figma file to connect to. See _figmaLibraryState.

_fontState.impact: Figma pushes and local rendering are now on-brand at every level, headings included.
_fontState.note: Uber Move Mono registers a duplicate dated face, 'Medium 190923'. Harmless for CSS, which matches on family and weight, but it may appear twice in Figma's font picker.
_fontState.separateQuestion: Serving the font to drivers in the webview remains unsettled. Installing locally for design and embedding on the web are different licence grants.

learningComponents._comment: Learning components built on Base (2026-09-28) and laid out after the Uber and Uber Eats apps (UBER-PATTERNS.md). Every one uses Base variables and text styles, and nests Base components where Base has them. Text styles are applied; run the Apply Uber type plugin once to measure the text in Uber Move and set the Base button labels.
